mapper.select: SELECT * FROM courses WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM courses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_topics t WHERE t.course_id = c.course_id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE') AS topicCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_topics t JOIN topic_progress p ON p.topic_id = t.topic_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE t.course_id = c.course_id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.status = 'LEARNED') AS learnedTopicCount, (SELECT t.title FROM course_topics t JOIN topic_progress p ON p.topic_id = t.topic_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE t.course_id = c.course_id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY t.order_index ASC, t.topic_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS currentTopicTitle FROM courses c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
AND c.course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET textbook_title = COALESCE(textbook_title, #{textbookTitle}), textbook_author = COALESCE(textbook_author, #{textbookAuthor}), textbook_publisher = COALESCE(textbook_publisher, #{textbookPublisher}), textbook_isbn = COALESCE(textbook_isbn, #{textbookIsbn}) WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE courses SET status = #{status} WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId}
